item.tib: srid pa'i rgyal mo'i gsang bskangs
item.coloph: srid pa'i rgyal mo'i gsang bskangs (skong) rdzogs so/ ('di'i bar zhang zhung gi smar chung 'dug) stong rgyung gi brnag pa gsang bskang (skong) 'di dang gcig srid rgyal sku gcig ma'i sgrub pa dang gnyis/ gnam phyi'i gsang sgrub dang gsum/ nag mo thugs kyis (kyi)gsang sgrub dang bzhi/ dam med lag tu ma shor cig gsang ba gnyer gtad do/ u ya ag tham//
